fields.name: Main Purpose / Request
fields.expected: To set 2014 priorities including hiring a permanent city manager and city attorney, establishing priority-based budgeting, and restoring city reserves.
fields.predicted: The Mayor encourages the City Council to accelerate efforts to regain public trust and outlines key priorities for 2014: (1) hiring a permanent city manager by March 1, 2014, (2) beginning the hiring process for a new city attorney no later than January 14, 2014, and (3) incorporating strategic priorities with a performance and priority-based budgeting process.

pageValues.value: The Mayor encourages the City Council to accelerate efforts to regain public trust and outlines key priorities for 2014: (1) hiring a permanent city manager by March 1, 2014, (2) beginning the hiring process for a new city attorney no later than January 14, 2014, and (3) incorporating strategic priorities with a performance and priority-based budgeting process.

To outline the benchmarks and timelines for performance and priority-based budgeting for fiscal year 2014-2015, and to highlight other important priorities for the City of Oxnard to address in 2014, including street resurfacing, job creation, general fund reserve restoration, school district collaboration, pension discussions, city marketing, levee funding, redevelopment properties, and self-sustaining operations for the Golf Course and Performing Arts Center.
